conclusions: Retained R12/G28 images completed exactly the same frozen corpus: steps, final source arena counts and word-tape hash agree.
Node row decode is additional sampled work (0.8–1.9% exclusive CPU including the reported profiler denominator), not an established explanation of the previous 7.81% unprofiled slowdown.
G28 GC share is LOWER in all three windows; the previous inference of increased GC is withdrawn.

Map.bit helpers dominate both images: 23.5–40.2% exclusive sampled CPU and 30.4–52.9% estimated sampled allocation. This motivates one independent Map.bit key-preserving traversal experiment on restored R12, not reintroduction of the rejected row store.
Inspector control overhead is separately attributed from node:inspector frames. No speed claim is inferred from profiled wall times.
